_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Yïn aye tïŋ Golf (Kɔ̈ɔ̈c Këdë) - Leek {player_id}.
Këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c: Gɔ̈k këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c. Na cïï këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c, këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c këdë 0.
Këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c: A=1, 2-10=këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c, J/Q=10, K=0

Këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c (lök këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c):
- '[draw]' - Tïŋ këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c
- '[take]' - Tïŋ këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c
- '[swap X Y]' - Këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c këdë X (riɛl) Y (kɔ̈ɔ̈m)
- '[discard]' - Këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c

board.drew:
Yin ee gɔ̈ɔ̈c: {card}
Kɔ̈ɔ̈c aye kɔ̈ɔ̈c [swap X Y] walla [discard].
board.took:
Yin ee kɔ̈ɔ̈c: {card} kɔ̈ɔ̈c kadiɛɛl
Kɔ̈ɔ̈c aye kɔ̈ɔ̈c [swap X Y] (aye kɔ̈ɔ̈c kadiɛɛl).

options.final_turns: Ku ɣɔn ku ɣɔn! Ku ɣɔn yin: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Yïn adhil: [swap X Y] (acïï lëu ba kaar kɔ̈ɔ̈c bei në kuer cï ke cuat yiic)
options.swap_or_discard: Yin ku ɣɔn ku ɣɔn: [swap X Y] ɣɛn [discard]

message.knocked: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {pid} acï cuɛt piny! Raan dɛ̈t ëbën anɔŋ yic bë lɔ̈ŋ tök bɛn looi.
message.final_round: Leeŋ {pid} {reason}! Kɔɔc juëëc aɣetɛɛm ëë rɔt.

invalid.wrong_action: Lök këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], ku [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Kä ye ke cuat yiic aa cïn kë tɔ̈ thïn!
invalid.must_draw_first: Yïn aye këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c [draw], [take], [knock], ku [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Yïn acïï lëu ba kaar cï nyaai në akuɔ̈t de kä ye ke cuat wei, yïn adhil bï waar.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Yïn aye këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c. Yïn aye këdë kɔ̈ɔ̈c [swap X Y] ku [discard] këdë.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Yïn awïc kaar cï kek bɛ̈n ya nyuɔɔth në kë bï yïn ke waar.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Yïn awïc kaar cï kek bɛ̈n riɔp ba ke cuat wei.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Piny atɔ̈ kɔ̈k ciɛ̈ŋ. Lök riɛl 1-{max_row}, kɔ̈ɔ̈m 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Yïn acïï lëu ba kë cï looi bɛ̈n yɔŋ. Luɔc tueŋ ku jɔl rot jal guiir.
invalid.already_knocked: Raan dɛ̈t acï bɛ̈n lɔ në ye mɛn.

board_str.title: === KËDË KËDË ===
